rule: SettleInvoice is never called for an invoice of an order fulfilled by another invoice; after reconciliation every superseded or late invoice is canceled in LND, so no order has two payable invoices.
message: reconcile recorded o1#1 as a late invoice (LND holds it OPEN while order o1 has another live invoice or no longer awaits payment) and did not call CancelInvoice for it in the pass
note: The 1.3.1 audit's F07. o1#1's AddInvoice is cut in transit; the creator's lookup finds nothing within the creation window, so it stays creating (steps 0-2). A first reconcile looks it up (3); the window passes (4); the create reaches LND late, o1#1 OPEN (5); a second reconcile lists o1#1 still creating and looks it up (6). The first lookup's stale NotFound lands: o1#1 is decided not-created (7). o1#2 is issued and OPEN (8-9). The second lookup's OPEN for o1#1 lands in the pass that began while it was creating (10): the pass has learned that o1#1 is payable beside o1#2 and must cancel it in LND now (11-12 answer its CancelInvoice and the lookup after it). The mutant records late-invoice, counts it open, and leaves both payable until a later pass.
